title: net_watch::latest() re-probes the routing table on the UI thread on every poll while the route reads offline
trigger: Disconnect the network (or have no route to Telegram) and leave Quill open; the screen poll and each background account poll call poll_ticks(.., net_watch::latest()) every pump
effect: Each pump runs route_now(): two UDP bind/connect calls plus a netlink socket (Linux), SCDynamicStore lookups (macOS) or GetBestRoute2 (Windows), all under the tracker mutex that the watcher thread also needs; wasted work and possible UI stalls while offline, multiplied by the number of background accounts
fix: Let the watcher thread own the probe and publish a NetworkState (epoch, available) in an atomic; latest() only reads it, with a rate-limited re-probe owned by the watcher while offline.

title: Neighbour resolution is tracked in three places kept in step by hand
trigger: A gateway whose link-layer address is not yet resolved: Tracker::resolving (gateways asked), link::Resolving v4/v6 AtomicBools (resolve thread in flight) and Path::carried/settled (hardware carried over from the previous route)
effect: No bug today; a failed link::resolve (UDP bind failure) is never retried because Tracker::resolving already names the gateway, and a resolve thread that never returns holds its IP version flag forever
fix: One per-gateway enum Neighbour { Unasked, Asking{since}, Resolved(mac), GaveUp } owned by Tracker, replacing the flags.

title: Coalesce is a dirty + running pair of atomics that must change together
trigger: Windows network change delivers dozens of callbacks on system threads
effect: Correct today (the loop re-checks dirty after clearing running); the stage is encoded by two bools instead of Idle/Running/RunningDirty
fix: A single AtomicU8 with states Idle, Running, RunningDirty and compare_exchange transitions.

title: StageFacts mirrors request liveness as bools next to the NewChatStage enum
trigger: New Group/Channel flow: create_pending, type_pending, type_failed and outcome are derived from Session.requests and info_edit_errors on each draw and combined with NewChatStage by view()
effect: Stage and facts can disagree (Creating with no outcome and no live request shows the back step unbusy; Type{saving:Some} with a request that vanished goes straight to Subscribers as if the save succeeded)
fix: Put the request state in the stage: Creating{request, state: Fetch<ChatId>} and Type{saving: Saving{requests, state: InFlight|Failed(reason)|Done}} updated by the answer, instead of re-deriving it from the session.

title: NewChatStage::Type.saving: Option<Vec<RequestId>> is a 'save attempted' flag cleared by hand
trigger: Type step: Save sends requests (saving=Some), a refusal is read from groups.info_edit_errors[chat] (keyed by chat, field Username, not by request); typing in the link field sets saving=None via new_chat_link_edited
effect: A refusal from a save that is not the one in flight is shown for the current one, and a save whose requests all vanished without an answer moves on to Subscribers as if it succeeded
fix: Type{chat, save: TypeSave} with TypeSave::{Editing, Saving(requests), Refused(reason)}; match the refusal by request id.

title: A create guarded by purpose, not by dialog: closing the dialog mid-create leaves a silent no-op Create and an unexpected chat open
trigger: New group: fill name and members, press Create, close the dialog before TDLib answers, reopen New Group and press Create again
effect: create_new_chat returns Ok(None) while the first request is out and the UI ignores it (button does nothing); when the first answer arrives run_new_chat_created calls select_chat for the group although its dialog is gone; NewChatState.creations entries are never removed
fix: Key the in-flight create to the dialog (a Creating stage the closing dialog cancels or hands to a toast) and drop the creations entry when its answer is applied.

title: Widget crash streak lives in a counter beside Lifecycle
trigger: A widget stops repeatedly (CPU/memory/validator limit)
effect: Whether a Stopped widget restarts depends on WidgetEntry::crashes (reset in widgets_ui.rs at content change and first frame, bumped on stop) and on runtime.is_none() in widget_bubble.rs, not on the Lifecycle value alone
fix: Lifecycle::Stopped{reason, streak: u8} and Lifecycle::GaveUp{reason}, so the streak resets when the variant changes.

title: Signal handler stage is IN_HANDLER + REPORT_DONE + INSTALLED atomics
trigger: A fault in one thread while another faults
effect: Works today (first thread writes, others wait up to 2 s); stage is three separate bools
fix: One AtomicU8 with Idle, Reporting, Reported.

title: Active crash report file is shared by every running instance of Quill
trigger: Start a second Quill process on the same logs folder (a second profile run or a second launch) while the first runs, then quit the second cleanly
effect: install() truncates native-crash-active.txt and the second instance's clean quit (discard_active) removes it, so a later crash of the first instance leaves a closed-fd report nobody finds; the first instance's start-up promote_previous can also file the second's report
fix: Name the active file by pid (native-crash-active-<pid>.txt) and promote only files whose pid is dead.

title: Background unread is a process-global atomic written by the UI at several call sites
trigger: Account switch, retire_live_to_background, take_background_live, poll, stop_background_clients each call publish_background_unread
effect: A path that changes background clients without calling publish_background_unread leaves the tray, dock badge and window title with the old other-accounts count (also read without an owner key by window_chrome.rs)
fix: Derive the badge from BackgroundAccounts::total_unread when drawing, or make the clients list the single writer through a setter that publishes.

title: Notification bursts coalesce by chat only, so forum topics merge
trigger: A forum supergroup gets a message in topic A then one in topic B before the queue drains
effect: One toast reading 'N new messages'; the inline reply target message_id is the newest message, in topic B, and the first topic's title/body is lost
fix: Key the queue by (chat, topic) using the ChatMessage/topic owner key.

title: A theme save that fails after the QR box closed is dropped without a word
trigger: Pick a new backdrop in your QR box, close the box (Closing sends setProfileShareTheme), then the request fails (offline, rights lost)
effect: The box is gone and the poll step clears save_answers when no box is open (ui/peer_qr/mod.rs drain_peer_qr), so no toast; the person believes the theme was saved but the server still has the old one
fix: Report a save failure through the app's note (set_note) when no box is open to take the answer, or keep the failed pick in the session until the next box shows it.

title: PeerQrBox save stage is chosen + saving + failed + save_serial + served kept in step by hand
trigger: Pick, close panel, save, fail, pick again, rights change
effect: chosen/saving/failed/served move together in apply(); a missed arm leaves a pick unsaved or resent
fix: One enum Theme { Following(served), Picked(choice), Saving{serial,choice}, SaveFailed(choice) } with the transitions in one place.

title: Old save answer overwrites served and clears failed of a newer pick
trigger: Save A (serial 1), pick B and close panel (serial 2 fails), answer for serial 1 arrives late
effect: save_answer applies Ok(saved) to served and failed = None even when the ticket serial is not the one in flight, so the failed pick can be sent again
fix: Apply Ok/Err to served/failed only when the ticket serial equals the saving serial; otherwise only update served from the session.

title: FreeState requesting + serial + menu_open are a request stage plus a menu stage
trigger: Click the pill, open the menu while a request is on its way, account price changes
effect: requesting, serial and menu_open are reset by hand in request, drop_pending, sync and pill_clicked
fix: enum FreeUi { Idle, MenuOpen, Requesting{request,serial} } so a request closes the menu by construction.

title: contact_link Fetch is paired with a separate contact_error Option
trigger: getUserLink for the contact link fails
effect: UserLinkFetch::Failed and contact_error are set together and cleared separately (retry_contact_link, drain_peer_qr take()); Failed with no error or error with no Failed can occur
fix: UserLinkFetch::Failed(Option<String>) with the box taking the reason once (Fetch<T> shape).

title: ThemeGifts stage is loaded + complete + loading + retry_at + requested_at
trigger: Open the gifts panel, scroll to the end, a next page fails, close and reopen
effect: five fields encode idle/first-loading/ready/more-loading/failed-retry; wants_more and fail() must keep them consistent by hand
fix: enum GiftsFetch { Idle, FirstLoading, Ready{more:bool}, LoadingMore, RetryAfter(i64) } carrying the serial.

title: Backdrops stage is loading bool + requested_at Option
trigger: Open the QR box with no network, then with network
effect: loading and requested_at must be set by start() and cleared by fail(); a dropped answer with neither accept nor fail leaves loading true and due() false for the session
fix: Fetch<Vec<ShareThemeBackdrop>> with a timestamp in the Ready/Failed variant.

title: PinReorder stage is dragging Option + dropped Option + slides, and the owner keeps pin_reorder_archived beside it
trigger: Drag a pinned chat, release, drag another before the slide ends
effect: dragging/dropped/slides must agree; ChatListUi::pin_reorder and pin_reorder_archived must be set together (set in pin_drag_move only)
fix: enum Reorder { Dragging{..}, Dropping{..} } and put archived inside PinReorder.

title: Release sends the pinned list as it was when the drag began, not as it is now
trigger: Start dragging a pinned chat; while holding, another device unpins chat X (or pins Y); release
effect: finish_pin_drag sends setPinnedChats with the begin-time snapshot: X is pinned again, Y is unpinned
fix: On release merge the dragged order into session.pinned_chat_ids (drop ids no longer pinned, keep new ones in place), or cancel the drag when the pinned set changes.

title: A drag whose release never reaches the list keeps dragging set and asks a frame every 60 ms
trigger: Begin a pinned drag, then Alt-Tab or lose the pointer capture so neither mouse_up nor mouse_up_out fires
effect: settled() stays false and sidebar upkeep (chat_list/sidebar.rs:325) keeps calling request_animation_tick(60) while dragging is Some, even when the window is inactive; the row stays lifted
fix: Cancel the reorder (release without saving) on window deactivation or when no button is down in the next move event.

title: Shuffle Previous/Next can return a message id that is no longer in the playlist
trigger: Shuffle music, skip a few tracks, delete one of the played messages, press Previous
effect: shuffled() returns played[cursor] without checking it is still in ids; the player is asked to start a missing message
fix: Filter played against ids before using the cursor (or drop vanished ids and re-seat the cursor).

title: ShuffleState played + cursor are two fields that move together and key tracks by a bare message id
trigger: Shuffle in chat A then play in chat B
effect: played ids carry no chat; note_current resets only when the current id is not at the cursor
fix: Key by (ChatId, MessageId) via OwnedBy and make the round one value with the cursor inside it.

title: PlaybackClock playing state is started_at Option beside base_secs
trigger: Let a track reach its end without the UI calling pause
effect: finished_at() stays true on every call while started_at is Some; the caller must pause to leave the state
fix: enum Clock { Paused{at}, Playing{from,since}, Ended } so the end is a stage with its own exit.

title: Keychain delete reports success on every error
trigger: Log out or delete an account on macOS when the keychain item is locked or the delete is refused
effect: KeychainSecretStore::delete maps Err(_) to Ok(()); the wipe path believes the database key is gone while it stays in the keychain
fix: Return Missing as Ok and map every other status to SecretStoreError::Locked/Platform, as get does.

title: A failed key put leaves the raw key in the .key.tmp file
trigger: Disk full or rename fails while storing a new database key on Linux
effect: write_key_file_0600 writes the unsealed key to db-encryption.key.tmp; when rename_retrying fails the tmp file is never removed
fix: Remove tmp on every error path after it was created (guard with a drop-removing file).

title: answer_on_exit leaves an unreaped child when no waiter thread can start
trigger: Thread spawn fails (resource limit) while opening a link
effect: The Err arm answers true and drops child without wait(); a zombie stays until Quill exits
fix: Hand the child to child_reap::wait_in_background as the Windows path does.

title: PollDraft keeps parallel vectors and two exclusive deadlines
trigger: Remove a middle option of a quiz draft, switch from a preset period to a custom date
effect: options, option_media and quiz_correct index the same rows and must be edited together; open_period and close_date are exclusive but both stored (PollClose already models it)
fix: Vec<DraftOption{text,media,correct}> and Option<PollClose> instead of parallel fields.

title: Result bars of 0% show for a poll that is yet unsent or scheduled
trigger: View a scheduled or unsent poll in a chat
effect: poll_shows_results is true for any vote_restriction_reason, including YetUnsent and Scheduled, so zero-percent bars replace the option choices
fix: Show results only for reasons where the user can never vote and results exist (Closed, Country, Membership), not for YetUnsent/Scheduled.
